desc:
🏎️ ONE spawner. ONE track. How far can you take it?

Drop toy cars onto your track and watch the cash roll in. Every machine a car drives through makes it worth more!

⚡ Build boosters, paint booths, car washes and scanners
🌀 Add stunt loops, jumps and a corkscrew tube
🛣️ Extend your track row by row, up to a second level
🚗 Upgrade your spawner from a Plastic Toy Car to a Quantum Hypercar
🌟 Catch golden cars, grab cash crates and hit TURBO
⭐ Rebirth for a permanent cash boost and do it all faster

🎁 Free daily rewards, playtime gifts and a lucky prize wheel
💾 Your track saves automatically

👍 Like and favourite for more updates!
